```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# Figure S7: cell type frequency assessment across aparasitemic and parasitemic children

```{r cell type frequency assessment, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='center',fig.height=12, fig.width=16}

#import the 82k object
temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1Z1gGEfNz7R-qYXizY7Sg6mzJxJkEm6Ti"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
refmapped.all<-readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

refmapped.all<-subset(refmapped.all, 
                      subset = predicted.celltype.l2 %in% 
                        c("B intermediate",
                             "B memory",
                             "B naive",
                             "Plasmablast",
                             "CD14 Mono",
                             "CD16 Mono",
                             "CD4 Naive",
                             "CD4 TCM",
                             "CD8 Naive",
                             "CD8 TCM",
                             "CD8 TEM",
                             "cDC1",
                             "cDC2",
                             "pDC",
                             "gdT",
                             "ILC",
                            "MAIT",
                           "NK",
                           "NK_CD56bright",
                           "Treg"
                           ))

# Extract metadata from total object
all_metadat<-refmapped.all@meta.data

cellfreq<-all_metadat%>%
     group_by(subject_id, phenotype, predicted.celltype.l2, .drop = FALSE) %>%
     summarise(n = n()) %>%
     mutate(freq = 100*(n / sum(n)))

# create paring
my_comparisons <- list("pair_1" = c("kali0666", "kali0650"), 
                       "pair_2" = c("kali0647", "kali0651"), 
                       #"pair_3" = c("kali0613", "kali0612"), 
                       "pair_4" = c("kali0618", "kali0628"), 
                       "pair_5" = c("kali0631", "kali0600"), 
                       "pair_6" = c("kali0626", "kali0640"), 
                       "pair_7" = c("kali0636", "kali0604"), 
                       "pair_8" = c("kali0585", "kali0593")) 
my_comparisons <- bind_rows(my_comparisons, .id = "pairing") 
my_comparisons <- t(my_comparisons) %>% 
                      as.data.frame()
my_comparisons<-my_comparisons%>%
  rownames_to_column(., var="pairing")%>%
pivot_longer(!pairing, values_to = "subject_id")

cellfreq_pairing<-cellfreq%>%  left_join(., my_comparisons,
by = "subject_id")
cellfreq_pairing<-cellfreq_pairing[,-c(1,4,7)]

cellfreq_pairing<-cellfreq_pairing%>%
  pivot_wider(.,names_from = "phenotype", values_from = freq)

#replace NA with zero for unrepresented samples
cellfreq_pairing[is.na(cellfreq_pairing)] <- 0

# For plotting
basefont <- "sans"
basefontsize <- 14
pvalfontsize <- 6
symnum.args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
gs.pal <- colorRampPalette(c("blue","red"),bias=.1,space="rgb")

#Plot 
cellfreq_paired_plot <- cellfreq_pairing%>%
ggpaired(., cond1 = "Aparasitemic", cond2 = "Parasitemic", id = "pairing",
color = "gray20",
fill = "condition",
line.color = "gray",
line.size = 0.4,
palette = c( "#3B9AB2", "#F21A00")) +
labs(y = "Percentage of total") +
stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", paired = TRUE,
label.x.npc = 0.5,
aes(label = paste0("p = ", after_stat(p.format)))) +
theme_bw() +
xlab("class (outcome)") +
ylab("Percentage of total") +
facet_wrap(~predicted.celltype.l2, scales = "free_y") +
theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
axis.title.y  = element_text(size=14),
axis.title.x  = element_text(size=14),
panel.background = element_blank(),
panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.border = element_rect(colour = "darkgrey", fill=NA, size=1),
plot.margin=unit(c(0.01,0.01,0.01,0.01), "null"))+
grids(linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))

cellfreq_paired_plot
```





```{r save fig_s7, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}

ggsave(paste0(figdir, "Figure S7- Cell type frequencies do not vary between aparasitemic and parasitemic
  subjects.pdf"), cellfreq_paired_plot, units = "in", height = 12, width = 16, bg = "white")

ggsave(paste0(figdir, "Figure S7- Cell type frequencies do not vary between aparasitemic and parasitemic
```
